name: mla_dsv4_sparse_decode_h512
description: DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA decode with the flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4 contract (flashinfer PR #4573): a single 512-d latent per token serves as key and value (no rope part), varlen query [sum_q, H, 512] with cum_seq_lens_q, two paged latent pools in HND ([pages, 1, page, 512]) or NHD ([pages, page, 1, 512]) layout (SWA pool with 256-token pages, optional compressed pool with 64- or 2-token pages), one combined int32 index table [sum_q, K] whose first 128 columns address the SWA pool (causal window of the last 128 positions, valid entries first, -1 padded) and whose remaining columns address the compressed pool, per-token active lengths sparse_topk_lens (counting the 128 SWA slots), per-request KV lengths, an fp32 attention-sink logit per head, bmm1_scale = 512**-0.55 and bmm2_scale = 1. Query and pools are bf16 or per-tensor float8_e4m3fn (kv_dtype); the output is bf16. Workloads are the PR's 94 rows: 84 decode rows (B=3, q_lens [3, 4, 5], two sequence-length cases, swa128 / swa128+topk4x / swa128+topk128x, H in {8, 16, 32, 64, 128}, both dtypes, both layouts), two guard rows (q 64 of kv 128; B=2 dense query [2, 5, H, 512] without cum_seq_lens_q) and eight prefill-style rows (B=2, q_lens [129, 257], 4K and 16K KV, swa128+topk4x, both dtypes).

num_heads.description: Query heads (H); one latent KV head.

num_seqs.description: Requests per call (B): 3 on decode rows, 1 / 2 on the guard rows, 2 on prefill-style rows.

sum_q.description: Query tokens; varlen rows: q_lens = round(linspace(ceil(max_q_len / 2), max_q_len, B)); dense row: num_seqs * max_q_len.

max_q_len.description: Longest per-request query length (5 decode, 128 seq_lens guard, 257 prefill-style).

cum_seq_lens_len.description: B + 1 on varlen rows; 0 on the dense row (cum_seq_lens_q is None).

swa_seq_len.description: KV length of request 0; request b has swa_seq_len + 256 * b.

num_swa_pages.description: Pages in the SWA pool (B * pages of the longest request).

swa_pool_dim1.description: Second dim of swa_kv_cache: 1 for HND, swa_page_size for NHD.

swa_pool_dim2.description: Third dim of swa_kv_cache: swa_page_size for HND, 1 for NHD.

compressed_page_size.description: Tokens per compressed pool page (64 or 2); 0 when the pool is absent.

compressed_seq_len.description: Base compressed length; request b has max(base, compressed_topk, max_q_len) + page_size * b.

num_compressed_pages.description: Pages in the compressed pool; 0 when absent.

compressed_pool_dim1.description: Second dim of compressed_kv_cache: 1 for HND, compressed_page_size for NHD; 0 when absent.

compressed_pool_dim2.description: Third dim of compressed_kv_cache: compressed_page_size for HND, 1 for NHD; 0 when absent.

sparse_topk.description: Index columns per token (K): 128 SWA slots plus compressed_topk.

kv_dtype.description: Dtype of query and both pools: bfloat16 or float8_e4m3fn (per-tensor FP8, scales 1).

kv_layout.description: Pool layout: HND [pages, 1, page, 512] or NHD [pages, page, 1, 512] (identical bytes for one KV head).

query_layout.description: 'varlen': query [sum_q, H, 512] with cum_seq_lens_q; 'dense': query [num_seqs, max_q_len, H, 512], cum_seq_lens_q and max_q_len None (upstream's dense-q guard row).

constraints: compressed_page_size == 0 implies compressed_kv_cache is None and sparse_topk == 128
query.dtype == swa_kv_cache.dtype == compressed_kv_cache.dtype == kv_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
kv_layout == 'HND' implies pools are [pages, 1, page_size, 512]; 'NHD' implies [pages, page_size, 1, 512]
query_layout == 'dense' implies cum_seq_lens_q is None, max_q_len is None and query is [num_seqs, max_q_len, H, 512]

query.description: Queries in kv_dtype: packed varlen [sum_q, H, 512] (shape), or [num_seqs, max_q_len, H, 512] (dense_shape) when query_layout is 'dense'.

swa_kv_cache.description: Paged SWA latent pool in kv_layout ([pages, 1, 256, 512] HND, [pages, 256, 1, 512] NHD); flat row = page * 256 + offset.

compressed_kv_cache.description: Paged compressed latent pool in kv_layout ([pages, 1, page, 512] HND, [pages, page, 1, 512] NHD); None on swa128 rows.

sparse_indices.description: Flat row indices: columns 0..127 into the SWA pool (valid first, -1 padded), 128.. into the compressed pool; -1 invalid.

sparse_topk_lens.description: Active columns per token, including the 128 SWA slots.

seq_lens.description: KV length per request (>= its query length).

cum_seq_lens_q.description: Packed query offsets; None on the dense row.

max_q_len.description: Longest query length in the batch; None on the dense row.

output.description: bf16 attention output in the query's shape: [sum_q, H, 512], or dense_shape on the dense row (also on fp8 rows).

reference:
import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    query: torch.Tensor,
    swa_kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
    compressed_kv_cache,
    sparse_indices: torch.Tensor,
    sparse_topk_lens: torch.Tensor,
    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
    cum_seq_lens_q: torch.Tensor,
    max_q_len: int,
    sinks,
    bmm1_scale: float,
    bmm2_scale: float,
    kv_layout: str = "HND",
):
    """
    DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA decode (flashinfer.decode.
    trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4 semantics) in fp32:

    • query and both pools are bf16 or per-tensor float8_e4m3fn (read exactly,
      no extra scaling); kv_layout only names the pools' layout ([pages, 1, page,
      512] HND or [pages, page, 1, 512] NHD hold identical bytes for one KV head).

    • one 512-d latent row serves as key and value; query is varlen
      [sum_q, H, 512] (cum_seq_lens_q / max_q_len only describe the packing) or,
      when cum_seq_lens_q is None, dense [B, max_q_len, H, 512] (flattened here;
      the output keeps the query's shape).
    • sparse_indices [sum_q, K] holds flat token-row indices
      (page * page_size + offset): columns 0..127 into swa_kv_cache
      [num_swa_pages, 1, 256, 512], columns 128..K-1 into compressed_kv_cache
      [num_compressed_pages, 1, page_size, 512]; -1 marks an invalid slot.
    • a slot is active when its index is >= 0 and its column is below
      sparse_topk_lens[t] (which counts the 128 SWA slots).
    • per token t and head h: scores = bmm1_scale * q[t, h] . row over the
      active slots, softmax with the extra logit sinks[h] (i.e. the row
      probabilities are divided by 1 + exp(sinks[h] - lse)), and
      out[t, h] = bmm2_scale * sum probs * rows; a token with no active
      slot outputs zeros. The result is bf16.
    • seq_lens [B] carries the KV length per request for the kernel's SWA
      window bookkeeping; the index tensor already encodes that window.
    """

    query_shape = query.shape
    if query.dim() == 4:  # dense [B, max_q_len, H, 512]: same math, flattened
        query = query.reshape(-1, query.shape[2], query.shape[3])
    sum_q, num_heads, head_dim = query.shape
    indices = sparse_indices.to(torch.int64)
    topk = indices.shape[1]
    columns = torch.arange(topk, device=query.device)
    active = (indices >= 0) & (columns[None, :] < sparse_topk_lens.to(torch.int64)[:, None])

    swa_rows = swa_kv_cache.reshape(-1, head_dim).float()
    rows = swa_rows[indices[:, :128].clamp_min(0)]  # [sum_q, 128, 512]
    if topk > 128:
        compressed_rows = compressed_kv_cache.reshape(-1, head_dim).float()
        rows = torch.cat([rows, compressed_rows[indices[:, 128:].clamp_min(0)]], dim=1)

    scores = torch.einsum("thd,tkd->thk", query.float(), rows) * float(bmm1_scale)
    scores = scores.masked_fill(~active[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
    lse = torch.logsumexp(scores, dim=-1)  # [sum_q, H]; -inf without active slots
    probs = torch.exp(scores - lse[..., None])
    probs = torch.where(active[:, None, :], probs, torch.zeros_like(probs))
    if sinks is not None:
        probs = probs / (1.0 + torch.exp(sinks.float()[None, :] - lse))[..., None]
    out = torch.einsum("thk,tkd->thd", probs, rows) * float(bmm2_scale)
    return out.to(torch.bfloat16).reshape(query_shape)
